## TA-T037 — least element / well-order / chain

Chosen rendering: **மீச்சிறு உறுப்பு / நன்கு வரிசைப்படுத்தல் / சங்கிலி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: Least means below all elements, distinct from merely minimal. Every nonempty subset must have a least element. Maximal chain means inclusion-maximal, not greatest cardinality.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P3 (checked_supports); TA-SC11-P19 (checked_context_only); TA-T037-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

## TA-T042 — integer / whole number / natural number

Chosen rendering: **முழு, முழுக்கள் / முழு எண், முழு எண்கள் / இயல் எண்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: Recovered canon supplies a sharper integer/whole-number distinction. Replace earlier முழு எண் for integer throughout current drafts with முழு (plural முழுக்கள்). Preserve OpenLogic natural-number convention including zero, despite school-text convention starting at one; explain separately.

Authority basis: TA-SC6-P29-NUMBERS (checked_context_only); TA-SC6-P169-GLOSSARY (checked_supports)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “முழு, முழுக்கள் / முழு எண், முழு எண்கள் / இயல் எண்” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “integer / whole number / natural number” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

## TA-T043 — numerical successor/predecessor versus tree cover

Chosen rendering: **தொடரி / முன்னி; மரவுருவில் அடுத்துறுப்பு / முந்துறுப்பு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: Recovered contextual evidence confirms தொடரி/முன்னி for n+1/n−1. Current relational chapters retain explicit அடுத்துறுப்பு/முந்துறுப்பு as generalized defined terms; record native alternatives without pretending school arithmetic attests arbitrary ordinal/tree covers.

Authority basis: TA-SC6-P2-SUCCESSOR (checked_context_only); TA-SC6-P169-GLOSSARY (checked_supports)

Alternatives: தொடரி / முன்னி are adopted for numerical use; parent/child vocabulary was considered for trees

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “தொடரி / முன்னி; மரவுருவில் அடுத்துறுப்பு / முந்துறுப்பு” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “numerical successor/predecessor versus tree cover” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

## TA-T045 — function / mapping / argument / value

Chosen rendering: **சார்பு / இணைப்பு / உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு / மதிப்பு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `false`; priority: `normal`.

Intended sense and rationale: சார்பு and மதிப்பு contextually attested; mapping expressed with the native linking idiom. உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு is a provisional explicit compound for the argument of a function, not a logical argument.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P26-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-SC11-P28-FUNCTION (checked_context_only)

Alternatives: செயலி / சார்பின் மாறி; logical வாதம் was rejected for function input

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “சார்பு / இணைப்பு / உள்ளீட்டுறுப்பு / மதிப்பு” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “function / mapping / argument / value” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

Chosen rendering: **பட்டியலாக்கம் / எண்ணிடத்தகாத**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: Enumeration explicitly means a possibly infinite list with finite positions or the source-defined map. Uncountable formed by negating the attested countable adjective; no separate direct headword attestation claimed.

## TA-T081 — formula / atomic formula / compound formula

Chosen rendering: **வாய்பாடு / அணு வாய்பாடு / கூட்டுவாய்பாடு**

## TA-T082 — valuation / evaluation function

Chosen rendering: **மெய்மதிப்பு ஒதுக்கீடு / மதிப்பீட்டுச் சார்பு**

Chosen rendering: **மெய்மம் / முரண்பாடு / நிச்சயமின்மையான**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: SCERT definitions match the all-true, all-false and neither classifications. OpenLogic contingent means satisfiable but not a tautology; that exact condition is retained even where the adjective is used.

Authority basis: TA-SC12V2-P269-SEMANTIC-SUMMARY (checked_context_only); TA-SC12V2-P282-GLOSSARY (checked_supports)

Alternatives: None recorded.

## TA-T089 — premise / conclusion / assumption / hypothesis / discharge

Chosen rendering: **முன்கோள் / முடிவு / எடுகோள் / கருதுகோள் / விடுவித்தல்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The logic original attests எடுகூற்று, முடிபு and எடுகோள்; current SCERT attests கருதுகோள் and முடிவு for a conditional. The edition uses முன்கோள் for an argument premise, முடிவு for its conclusion, எடுகோள் for a temporary formal assumption, and defines discharge as ending that assumption's formal scope.

## TA-T097 — antecedent / succedent / end-sequent

Chosen rendering: **முன்தொடர் / பின்தொடர் / இறுதித் தொடரணி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The sequent definition displays both finite sequences and their separator, then gives the truth-condition in full. முன்தொடர் and பின்தொடர் keep the sequent sides distinct from SCERT's conditional-statement முன்னிலை and பின்னிலை; இறுதித் தொடரணி is fixed as the bottom sequent of a derivation tree.

Authority basis: TA-IL1967-P112-113-INFERENCE (checked_supports); TA-SC6-P169-GLOSSARY (checked_supports); TA-SC12V2-P255-CONDITIONAL (checked_context_only); TA-T097-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **is “முன்தொடர் / பின்தொடர் / இறுதித் தொடரணி” the established India-standard Tamil expression for “antecedent / succedent / end-sequent” in the exact senses at the listed segments; if not, what replacement preserves the distinctions in the rationale?**

## TA-T100 — variable / constant symbol / closed term / main operator

Chosen rendering: **மாறி / மாறிலிக் குறி / மூடிய சொல் / முதன்மைச் செயலி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: SCERT directly attests propositional variables and logical connectives. The broader first-order variable, constant-symbol, closed-term and main-operator senses are fixed by adjacent syntactic clauses; closed means no variables, and main operator is the connective or quantifier governing the displayed formula.

Authority basis: TA-SC12V2-P253-CONNECTIVES (checked_context_only); TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-T100-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **is “மாறி / மாறிலிக் குறி / மூடிய சொல் / முதன்மைச் செயலி” the established India-standard Tamil expression for “variable / constant symbol / closed term / main operator” in the exact senses at the listed segments; if not, what replacement preserves the distinctions in the rationale?**

Chosen rendering: **நிறுவல்-கோட்பாட்டுக் கருத்து / தேற்றம் / வருவிக்கத்தக்கதன்மை / வருவிக்கவியலாமை / இறுக்கத்தன்மை**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The preserved logic original supplies the proof and inference register, while OpenLogic immediately defines theoremhood and derivability through LK sequents. Nonderivability is the explicit negation of that relation, and compactness is fixed by the two finite-subset clauses rather than claimed as an independently attested headword.

## TA-T112 — first-order logic / quantificational logic / predicate logic / metalogical investigation

Chosen rendering: **முதல்தர தருக்கம் / அளவையடைத் தருக்கம் / பயனிலைத் தருக்கம் / மேல்தருக்கவியல் ஆய்வு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The checked sources support the quantifier, predicate, formal statement and proof components but do not supply one uniform modern label for first-order metatheory. The edition uses முதல்தர தருக்கம் consistently as the principal name, gives the two source-listed alternate names in context, and reserves மேல்தருக்கவியல் for mathematical claims relating derivability to semantics.

Authority basis: TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-SC12V2-P252-STATEMENT (checked_context_only); TA-IL1967-P264-265-PROOF (checked_supports); TA-T112-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Chosen rendering: **மீள்வரையறை / முதன்மை மீள்வரையறை / பகுதி மீள்வரையறைச் சார்பு / பொதுவான மீள்வரையறைச் சார்பு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: மீள்வரையறை continues the edition's established recursive-definition usage. The chapter itself distinguishes the immediately preceding-value schema, closure with unbounded search, partiality and regular-function restriction; the modifiers are therefore fixed by explicit formulas rather than asserted as independently attested textbook headwords.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-IL1967-P112-113-INFERENCE (checked_supports); TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-T114-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

The checked passages support proof and function register but not these exact modern headwords.

## TA-T122 — configuration / initial configuration / run / halt / output

Chosen rendering: **அமைவுநிலை / தொடக்க அமைவுநிலை / இயக்கம் / நிற்றல் / வெளியீடு**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `false`; priority: `normal`.

Intended sense and rationale: The configuration triple fixes tape content, head position and state; the run definition then fixes one-step succession, halting and normalized output. அமைவுநிலை avoids conflating an instantaneous machine configuration with an abstract model-theoretic structure.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-SC12V2-P254-TRUTH-TABLES (checked_context_only); TA-IL1967-P264-265-PROOF (checked_supports)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Please double-check: **do the listed uses of “அமைவுநிலை / தொடக்க அமைவுநிலை / இயக்கம் / நிற்றல் / வெளியீடு” preserve the OpenLogic sense of “configuration / initial configuration / run / halt / output” and read naturally in India-standard mathematical Tamil?**

## TA-T126 — halting function / halting problem / diagonal argument / unsolvable

Chosen rendering: **நிற்றல் சார்பு / நிற்றல் சிக்கல் / மூலைவிட்ட வாதம் / தீர்க்கவியலாத**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: The indexed zero-one definition fixes the halting function and the self-input construction fixes the diagonal contradiction. தீர்க்கவியலாத is reserved for a problem lacking a decision procedure, while தீர்மானிக்கவியலாத remains the property adjective used for sets and questions.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P27-FUNCTION (checked_context_only); TA-IL1967-P264-265-PROOF (checked_supports); TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-T126-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

Alternatives: None recorded.

## TA-T130 — axiomatized / axiomatizable / induction schema / Robinson Q / Peano arithmetic

Chosen rendering: **அடிகோளாக்கப்பட்ட / அடிகோளாக்கத்தக்க / தொகுத்தறிதல் வார்ப்புரு / ராபின்சனின் Q / பியானோ எண்கணிதம்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: அடிகோள் continues the proof-system register. Axiomatizability is defined by a decidable axiom set, the induction schema by its fully displayed quantified formula, and the two arithmetic theories by their exact axiom collections; personal names are transparently transliterated.

Authority basis: TA-IL1967-P264-265-PROOF (checked_supports); TA-SC12V2-P254-TRUTH-TABLES (checked_context_only); TA-TVA-D0412-QUANTIFIER (checked_supports); TA-T130-EXACT-TERM-NOT-FOUND (not_found)

## TA-T131 — representability / independent sentence / Gödel sentence / arithmetization of syntax

Chosen rendering: **பிரதிநிதித்துவப்படுத்தல் / சார்பற்ற வாக்கியம் / கோடல் வாக்கியம் / தொடரமைப்பின் எண்கணிதமாக்கம்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `low`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: No exact specialist headwords were found in the checked sources. Function and relation representability are defined by the required numeral instances provable in a theory; independence by failure to derive either a sentence or its negation; and arithmetization by effective coding of symbols, formulas and derivations as natural numbers.

## TA-T153 — lambda term / alpha-equivalent / bound and free variable / capture-avoiding substitution

Chosen rendering: **லாம்டா சொல் / α-சமானம் / கட்டுண்ட மற்றும் கட்டற்ற மாறி / பிடிப்பைத் தவிர்க்கும் இடைநிறுத்தல்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: சொல், மாறி, கட்டுண்ட, கட்டற்ற and இடைநிறுத்தல் continue the reviewed first-order syntax register. Under TA-LAM-002, a variable occurrence is bound only by the nearest enclosing lambda abstraction for that same variable; otherwise it is free, exactly as the adjoining y/z/x example requires. Alpha-equivalence is defined by renaming bound variables only, and capture-avoiding substitution requires prior renaming whenever a free variable of the substituting term would be captured. No direct Tamil lambda-calculus attestation is claimed.

## TA-T171 — entailment / entails / counterexample / class of models / reflexive model

Chosen rendering: **பின்விளைவு / இலிருந்து பின்விளைகிறது / எதிரெடுத்துக்காட்டு / மாதிரிகளின் வகுப்பு / தற்சுட்டு மாதிரி**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `high`; provisional: `false`; priority: `low`.

Intended sense and rationale: பின்விளைவு and எதிரெடுத்துக்காட்டு continue the reviewed propositional and first-order semantic register. The universal model-and-world clause fixes local modal consequence, while the two explicit failing models fix the negated relation. தற்சுட்டு is the directly attested SCERT term for reflexive relations and is used consistently for accessibility relations and their models.

Authority basis: TA-SC11-P19 (checked_context_only); TA-SC12V2-P251-LOGIC (checked_supports); TA-SC12V2-P252-STATEMENT (checked_context_only); TA-SC12V2-P269-SEMANTIC-SUMMARY (checked_context_only); TA-IL1967-P112-113-INFERENCE (checked_supports); TA-TVA-N-6.3-OPEN (checked_context_only)

Alternatives: None recorded.

Chosen rendering: **இடவியல் / இடவியல் வெளி / திறந்த கணம் / உட்பகுதி / இடவியல் பொருண்மையியல்**

Kind: `terminology`; confidence: `medium`; provisional: `true`; priority: `high`.

Intended sense and rationale: இடவியல், வெளி, கணம், உட்பகுதி and பொருண்மையியல் use established Tamil mathematical and edition components. The three displayed topology axioms define the open sets, the largest-open-subset clause defines interior, and the recursive valuation clauses define the specialist semantic compound in place. The complete compound இடவியல் பொருண்மையியல் is treated as provisional rather than claimed as a directly attested headword.
